alternativesConsidered.name: 2003 Google Books ebook preview listing
alternativesConsidered.notes: Authorized preview page for the same 2003 work family. Useful for lawful metadata and part-heading support, but the Open Library print-reference record is cleaner for package identifiers.

alternativesConsidered.name: 2017 CreateSpace reprint
alternativesConsidered.notes: Later English reprint of the same core work family. It does not offer a better chapter map than the 2003 reference edition.

alternativesConsidered.name: 2004 abridged audio edition
alternativesConsidered.notes: The abridged audio record exposes only 62 tricks, which materially changes scope and chapter-level coverage, so it is excluded from this run.

decisionRationale: Open Library exposes the 2003 print-reference identifiers and the full nine-part table of contents, which is the most stable source for package chapter numbering in this run.
Google Books confirms the same 2003 work family, gives the nine part headings with start pages, and confirms the domain counts that sum to 92 techniques.
The official Lowndes page confirms the same work family and general positioning without showing a conflicting structure.
No translation or materially different English chapter order was found that would change part order, chapter scope, or chapter-level interpretation for the nine-part package.
The abridged audio variant is materially different and therefore excluded rather than treated as an equal edition candidate.

operatingRules.chapterGranularity: official nine-part package chapters with the 92 named tricks preserved as internal source headings
